capabilities.description: Lets a client select a service or slot and submit a booking request, capturing the minimum details needed for a booking.
requirements: a simple booking flow with confirmation notification

capabilities.description: Gives staff an admin dashboard to view, manage, and update incoming bookings.
Sends a confirmation message to the client when a booking is submitted, using a notification channel.
Authenticates clients and staff so that bookings and admin views are tied to the correct identity.
Records an auditable log of bookings and admin actions for traceability.
Config capability (reused from the block store)
Email capability (reused from the block store)

drafting_note: inventory: 'product' is not on the declared-ready list (construction, finance, finance_ops, hotel_management, insurance, retail); the Store kit for this vertical is unverified — domain depth not guaranteed
summary: A simple pilot-level test platform that lets clients make bookings online while staff manage them through an admin view. The build defaults to a basic booking flow with confirmation notifications and a staff admin dashboard. No document answering (price lists, catalogues, policies) is configured, and no money handling (deposits or payments) is enabled until the client supplies country and currency details.
